title: Prove routing and Fourier component results with exact checks
body:
This retains completed routing and Fourier component results with reproducible checks. The [proof guide](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c852c9e132e296607a5d39e687281ea89e55dc8/research/legacy-outer-analysis/README.md), [frozen source manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c852c9e132e296607a5d39e687281ea89e55dc8/research/legacy-outer-analysis/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json), and [independent agent review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c852c9e132e296607a5d39e687281ea89e55dc8/research/legacy-outer-analysis/review/REVIEW.md) give the precise interfaces. There is no complete supplier or verified change to kappa.

The package makes three scoped results available:

- The retained arbitrary ADDRESS router needs only polylogarithmic spectator fields. This removes its old `epsilon > a` short-width condition and retains the bound `O(V p^tau polylog p + poly p)`. Full binary boxes, equal-width interchange, complete scalar records, and fixed tapes remain assumptions.
- Every complete tensor left inverse of the declared periodic Gaussian sampler has infinity norm greater than `2^(d(u/3-1))`. The proof includes joint inverses that do not factor by axis. Its normalization cost remains `Omega(d*u)` under the stated arbitrary-input disk interface.
- For each odd prime `q`, a polynomial-time search selects a root whose Newton prefix products lie between `2^(-1000 h^3)` and `2^(1000 h^3)`, for `h=ceil(log2(q))`. The accompanying carry arguments identify why a fixed sector gauge still does not provide the missing convolution supplier.

These results remove one routing restriction, provide a conditioned root choice, and rule out a specific normalization shortcut. They do not price a full sector-packing implementation, scalar rounding program, or recursive supplier. The old numerical parameter comparisons are excluded from the claims.

The base is [cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703). The router builds on the RaD/hipotures interfaces from [PR #20](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/20), pinned through the [retained source record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c852c9e132e296607a5d39e687281ea89e55dc8/research/legacy-outer-analysis/vendor/references/semantic-bulk/rad20/SOURCE.json). The Gaussian and Newton definitions come from the [pinned OpenAI manuscript](https://github.com/openai/math/tree/adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a/preprints/An-explicit-power-saving-for-the-exact-discrete-Fourier-transform-September-25-2026), with the [eumemic exact-DFT note](https://github.com/eumemic/exact-dft-bounds/blob/6f87d1a0c9ae462cdcb2034a1361c87623221e66/notes/batched-dft-note.tex) supplying related exact identities. The [notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c852c9e132e296607a5d39e687281ea89e55dc8/research/legacy-outer-analysis/NOTICE.md) retains the contributor lineage and distinguishes the CC0 and Apache-2.0 sources. No author identity or literature-priority claim is inferred from a submitter account.

From the repository root, with Python 3, its standard library, assertions enabled, and a new output path:

```sh
python3 -B research/legacy-outer-analysis/verify.py --work /tmp/outer-component-replay
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_LEGACY_OUTER_ANALYSIS checks=6
```

All six checks passed in a new independent replay. Coverage includes 4,280 complete tiny routing addresses, 227 Gaussian size pairs, 8,256 root-choice prefixes, and the exact carry identities. Larger address and discrepancy probes are samples; the written arguments establish the general claims. The [review record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c852c9e132e296607a5d39e687281ea89e55dc8/research/legacy-outer-analysis/review/REVIEW-STATUS.json) binds the proof and executable inputs. A disclosed portability change replaces only a Git revision lookup with a pinned text file.

No selected-frontier cold replay, full multiplication theorem, hosted CI success, or proof-assistant result is claimed. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used for the research and packaging. The independent review is by a separate agent, not a human. Complete sector packing and the paid precision interface remain open.
